name: io.github.Servosity/blumira-mcp
title: Blumira MCP
description: Cross-account Blumira findings, detections, and agents in one offline-searchable store.

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-minted Blumira JWT. An alternative to BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID + BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET: set this OR the Client ID/Secret pair.

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Blumira API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Blumira API Client ID (Settings > Organization > Generate API Credentials). With BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET, the server mints and auto-refreshes a JWT.

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Blumira API Client Secret, paired with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID to mint a JWT (OAuth2 client_credentials, audience public-api).

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every write from the MCP server (read tools only).

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses (reads go to the API; the response cache is off).

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Blumira requests.

environmentVariables.name: BLUMIRA_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (at least 32 characters). Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
